speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with Venous Stasis Ulcer.

The history of chronic bilateral leg swelling, a family history of similar issues, and a prior DVT strongly suggests venous insufficiency, which aligns with the non-healing nature of this 6-month-old wound. The lack of bacterial growth on culture and normal blood counts further supports a non-infectious etiology driven by venous hypertension rather than arterial ischemia or acute infection.
